import sys

def reverse_integer(n):
    sign = -1 if n < 0 else 1
    n = abs(n)
    reversed_num = 0
    while n > 0:
        reversed_num = reversed_num * 10 + n % 10
        n //= 10
    return sign * reversed_num

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    print(reverse_integer(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
